name: Magnetic Palm Grip and Mini Tripod for Phones
description: A handheld magnetic phone grip that extends into a selfie stick on a mini tripod.

specs.label: What's included
specs.value: Magnetic ring, wrist strap, USB-C charging cable

source.notes: Grip and tripod version only (no fill light, no clamp), white, from the 1688 style "white-z3 magnetic zoom model four-in-one": cost CNY 159.80 (owner, 2 Nov 2026), fx 223.33; price 79500 = 55% target rounded up (owner said about 78000). Same shop and listing as the M27: store return rate 28.7% (flagged), 1 review (3 stars). WONEW / Colorful Snail brand kept out of name and copy. Sea only (battery likely), owner confirmed. "Four-in-one", "zoom" and remote not claimed (unexplained / Is1 unclear). Photo: clean white grip alone, 800 px upscaled (soft); does not show the tripod form. Weight 200-250 g per page. Black not listed (no photo). Price raised from NGN 79500 to NGN 90000 on 9 Nov 2026 (owner approved margin review: 60% floor).

supplier.name: Dongguan Liangmei Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
